short_reading.title: A Night at the Theatre
short_reading.text: Mai and her mum go to the theatre. They see a musical about a princess. The costumes are beautiful, and the songs are great. The audience claps at the end.

questions.q: What does the audience do at the end?

short_reading.title: My Favourite Programme
short_reading.text: My favourite programme is a series about a dragon. I watch one episode every Saturday. My brother is a big fan too. After the show, we tell our mum the plot.

questions.q: When does he watch an episode?
